question: Which AI-powered platform was launched by Satya Nadella and Devendra Fadnavis to fast-track cybercrime investigations in Maharashtra?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MahaCrimeOS AI.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Microsoft Chairman Satya Nadella and Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis launched MahaCrimeOS AI, India’s first AI-powered cybercrime investigation platform.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **MahaCrimeOS AI is developed by CyberEye in collaboration with Microsoft and Maharashtra Government’s SPV MARVEL.**
 
• **The platform uses Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service and Microsoft Foundry for AI-powered investigation assistance.**
 
• **It is already live in 23 police stations in Nagpur and will be expanded to all 1,100 police stations across Maharashtra.**
 
• **The platform aims to significantly speed up cybercrime case resolution by augmenting police officers with AI tools.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Global Capacity Centre (GCC)**__

 __
 
• Brookfield announced a $1 billion investment to build Asia’s largest GCC in Maharashtra.
 
• The centre will cover 2 million sq ft and generate 15,000 direct and 30,000 indirect jobs.
 
 
 
• **Microsoft’s India Investment**__
 __
 
• Microsoft recently announced a $17.5 billion investment in India for 2026–2029.
 
• Focus areas include cloud infrastructure, AI skilling and operational expansion.
 
 
 
• **AI Copilot Expansion**__
 __
 
• Maharashtra and Microsoft discussed expanding AI-driven governance solutions to health, education, agriculture and public service delivery.
 
 
 
• **FedEx GCC Proposal**__
 
 
• The state government is in talks with FedEx to set up a GCC between Mumbai and Pune, leveraging the new Navi Mumbai International Airport.
